properties.name: hall_surround
properties.digitised_from: derived: 35-150 m ring around the hall footprints, clipped to the campus, minus digitised yards
properties.note: Ring around the halls where chillers, dry coolers and switchgear are normally placed, together with adjacent paving and laydown. Measured to ask whether load-related heat is visible next to the halls at night when the roofs show none. Not a clean heat-rejection polygon.
